name: Dartmouth College
header:
Dartmouth College
United States · Mathematics PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Four years of U.S. English-medium study required for stated degree exemption.
• Central fee$150 conflicts with mathematics all-applicant fee waiver.
• John Voight is currently Professor at the University of Sydney, not an ordinary Dartmouth prospective adviser;
old Dartmouth webpages remain online. Current Sydney appointment verified on official faculty page.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
International applicants and U.S. undergraduate degree holders are expressly contemplated. UChicago
bachelor’s is an appropriate degree route; exact degree conferral and mathematics preparation reviewed by
program. [s2]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare upper-level course/textbook list; use Guarini online application, no paper materials; resolve
mathematics-specific fee waiver before payment. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
Department contact deptaa@math.dartmouth.edu; supplement asks research-area interests. Required
advance adviser commitment not established. [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
All uploads online; application acknowledgement does not mean complete. Use status portal for materials and
references; applicant can revise contact/self-reported tests/references but not uploaded essays/CV/transcripts
after submission. [s2] [s3] [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Department explicitly states December 15, 2026; funding published for 2026-27 only. [s1] [s5]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
TOEFL, IELTS and Duolingo accepted; recommendations are old TOEFL 100/new 5, IELTS 7, DET 135.
Self-report during application, official reports after admission as directed. [s2] [s3]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Exemption includes earned or currently earning bachelor’s/higher degree after at least four years at U.S.
institution where English is sole primary instruction language. UChicago qualifies if four-year study condition
met; shorter attendance/transfer route needs confirmation. [s2]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional; encouraged when applicant believes scores strengthen file. Unofficial scores accepted during
application. Once reported, central instructions say scores cannot be removed/suppressed. [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Academic records
sections.text:

Upload most recent unofficial transcripts; no official paper records during application. Admitted matriculants
undergo official credential verification (ReVera instructions later). [s2] [s4]

special format found. [s2]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three required; up to four accepted. [s2]
Scholarship references; What sends the invitation [Unresolved]
This specific reference detail was not established by the public program/graduate application instructions
checked. Confirm it in the current referee-help screen or with admissions before entering contacts; no
invitation was triggered during research. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
References may be added/updated and reminders sent after applicant submission, but all must meet deadline.
[s3] [s4]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal tracks receipt; email confirmation issued for letter receipt, with resend/reminder functionality. [s4]
Updating and reusing letters [Unresolved]
Applicant can update reference details/add recommenders after submission; replacing actual received letters
or reusing previous-cycle letters not established. Writer must author letter; official letterhead or explanation
requested. [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Unresolved]
Resume/CV category appears in mathematics application requirements, but page has no detailed text defining
mandatory flag, prompt, limit or formatting. Confirm live portal. [s2]

Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
Required personal essay, maximum 1000 words (paraphrase): use one or two concrete turning points to
explain route to graduate study and relevant preparation; explain intellectual questions/skills/problems that
motivate you; explain Guarini/Dartmouth faculty/resources/community fit. Online submission; file formatting
beyond portal unverified. [s2]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Same 1000-word personal essay as SOP; no separate background essay established on public math page. [s2]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Program supplement asks degree of interest in each research area. Essay also addresses intellectual goals.
Separate research statement not established. [s2]
Research proposal; Writing sample / thesis / research summary; Publications list; Scholarship
essays [Unresolved]
The public mathematics and graduate-admissions pages checked do not establish a separate requirement or
permission to submit this item. Required/optional status, exact prompt, length, formatting and
upload-versus-link instructions remain unverified; check the current portal before drafting or sending an extra
document. [s1] [s2] [s3]
Course-list document [Standing rule]
Required uploaded list of upper-level mathematics courses and textbooks used. No public page/word limit or
special format found. [s2]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Guarini requires essay entirely applicant’s own work; permits AI for program research/grammar but disallows
using it to outline/draft/write the essay. Referees must solely author letters. CV/transcript/essays cannot be
revised after submission. [s3] [s4]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
2026-27 university PhD package: $49,862.40 for 12 months, tuition, health insurance and relocation bonus
(amount not stated here). This is not a published 2027-28 rate. [s5]
Years of support [Standing rule]
Five years guaranteed for PhD students in good standing, subject to available funds, satisfactory performance
and progress. [s5]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
Mathematics support statement covers all admitted PhD students, including international admissions route;
individual offer controls. [s1] [s2]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Continued satisfactory progress/performance and good standing; funding page also notes availability of funds.
[s5]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Mathematics support automatic; no separate funding application. [s1]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Internal fellowships and research grants available; exact eligibility and applications award-specific. NSF is not
an international-student default route. [s5]
Application fee [Conflict]
Department application page says fees waived for all applicants, while central mathematics page lists$150.
Resolve automatic waiver with department before paying. [s1] [s2]

Fee waiver [Conflict]
All-applicant mathematics waiver advertised by department; central page$150 conflicts. No retroactive
refund/waiver under general rules. [s1] [s2] [s3]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Asher Auel
Brauer groups and rationality, arithmetic of K3 surfaces/cubic fourfolds, and Brill-Noether geometry. [faculty1]
[faculty1a]
Current Dartmouth faculty; CV header says Professor while appointment table still repeats Associate Professor, so rank should be
confirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Splitting Brauer classes by genus one curves over number fields
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Juliette Bruce
Algebraic geometry and commutative algebra via syzygies, positivity, tropical geometry, and arithmetic
varieties. [faculty3] [faculty3a]
Assistant Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Level structures on tropical abelian varieties
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Rosa C. Orellana
Combinatorial representation theory, symmetric-group characters, symmetric functions, plethysm and
diagram/partition algebras. [faculty6] [faculty6a]
Professor of Mathematics; official current directory confirms appointment. New-student capacity unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Rook characters as symmetric functions
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
